posts.t: Sturm with an assist for his point of the season, too.

Wild roster update ahead of the five-game road trip, per Hynes: 

-Foligno brothers will not travel to start the trip
-Maatta, Spurgeon and Sturm will travel to start the trip

Kaprizov (illness) and Hughes (rest day) did not practice today.

M. Foligno and Spurgeon skated with the team. Hynes doesn't anticipate them playing tomorrow. 

N. Foligno is skating on his own. 

Sturm is doing well.

Wallstedt in net tomorrow. No lineup changes expected.
